Constraint: Fleet 0805 bulk cap, 16 V X5R. DO NOT cost-reduce to a 6.3 V or 10 V part: C8/C9 sit on raw pack voltage (7.4 V nominal, 8.4 V on a full 2S) and CR1 does not clamp until 11.1 V, so 16 V is the floor. OPEN CHECK on C11/C13/C15 (first-stage COUT): TI specifies a 40-80 uF EFFECTIVE window at 3.33 V bias, not a minimum, because the loop compensation is internal and non-adjustable (SLVSFP4B 8.2.2.2.3). Verify three of this part against its DC-bias curve before ordering -- a 16 V X5R derates far less than the 6.3 V part the review assumed, so it should land near the bottom of the window rather than under it, but it is close enough to be worth confirming.
C16 is the V_IO decoupling cap added by the pre-fab review.
VIN high-frequency cap. Fleet part is X7R 16 V, adequate here.
C_NR/SS: TI characterisation value, sets a 5.0 ms soft start.
Do not substitute SMF12A. Standoff 10 V clears a full 8.4 V 2S pack; Vc max 17 V at 11.8 A stays under the TPS62913's 18 V absolute maximum. SMF12A clamps at 19.9 V and would exceed it.

Green Vf is load-bearing on D1: it is the only thing holding TIMEPULSE/SAFEBOOT_N above the safeboot threshold at startup. Do not fit a low-Vf part and do not replace D1 with a plain resistor to ground.
20 ohm at 100 MHz / 8 mohm DCR / 5 A. L ~= 31.8 nH, inside the 50 nH stability limit for the internal compensation (SLVSFP4B 8.2.2.2.4).
Pads are tied to GND. DIN965 is a countersunk head and will not seat flat on a plain pad.
Pin 5 carries TIMEPULSE (PPS) on this board. On gnss-px1105r the same pin is RXD2, driven by the host. Board is silkscreened accordingly.
LED series. At 10 k both LEDs run 0.13 mA and are barely visible indoors; 1.5-2.2 k gives ~7x brightness and stays inside the 2 mA TIMEPULSE limit. 1.5 k is already a fleet part (RC0402FR-071K5L).
R7/R8 are UART series protection; R9 is the PPS series resistor into J3.5, added by the pre-fab review.
FB divider high side. With R6 and Vfb = 0.800 V this sets 3.330 V.
FB divider low side; TI reference value.
Patch antenna faces the B.Cu side of the board.
